scope: Local loopback real WebSockets; scripted SDK controls without browser rendering/prediction; not WAN or hosting qualification
measurementNotes: Work p95 and p99 values describe the most recent bounded server window of 256 observations. The event-loop histogram covers the running process.
The fixture uses a Python loopback TCP relay to pause a real viewer. Only that viewer should hit the 64 KiB backlog guard.
The SDK load generator drives authoritative gameplay inputs. The browser suite separately covers rendering, control, promotion, and reload.
